description: Navigate to the Reading category in GCompris and launch the 'Reading practice' activity (icon usually shows a word pointing to an image, or a book/ABC symbol). In this activity, a word is displayed, and you must click the matching image. Complete at least 5 words/levels. As you play, create a log file at '/home/ga/Documents/reading_log.txt' listing the words you successfully matched. The log should have one word per line (e.g., 'ball', 'car', 'flower').
